runtimePolicy.reason: Each market exports the distribution (Poisson or NB2) selected on validation mean line logLoss with a 0.0005 deadband; NB2 coefficients come from a GLM refit of the tuned pipeline. Isotonic line calibrators are embedded only when their cross-fitted within-validation gain clears the same deadband.
runtimePolicy.refereeFeatures: Missing referee-at-fixture data are imputed from training medians.
